planning_notes: Wiring is exactly preserved: D2 increment button, D3 decrement button, TM1637 CLK=D4 and DIO=D5, buzzer on D6.
Button inputs are modeled as active-high at the model level: io_i=true means pressed (no additional inversion in the model).
Counter initial value is not explicitly specified in the requirements; tm1637_number initial is set to 0 to match the lower bound and allow immediate correct display.
Buzzer behavior (alarm tones and 'no further越界动作') is handled in SysML; this proposal only defines the I/O ports, not timers/threshold logic.
No serial requirements were provided; therefore no serial_channels are configured.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button increment; pressed => true; used to add 1 unless out of range

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Button decrement; pressed => true; used to subtract 1 unless out of range

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer alarm when counter reaches upper limit 20 or lower limit 0; silence otherwise

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 real-time display of counter value (0..20); out-of-range requests blanked

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个多功能计数与显示系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于加一计数，D3 用于减一计数，数码管实时显示计数值；当计数达到上限 20 或下限 0 时蜂鸣器报警，并禁止继续越界。
